newsitem.title: USA: GM sets Olympic marketing deals - NYT.
newsitem.headline: GM sets Olympic marketing deals - NYT.

text.p: General Motors Corp is expected to announce a sponsorship agreement with General Electric's NBC and the United States Olympic Committee that would run into the next decade and be worth several hundred million dollars, the New York Times reported.

In Monday's edition, the Times cited "persons familiar with the deal" who said the three parties were still negotiating the full value of the sponsorship in terms of commercial television time, fees to the Olympic Committee, promotional spending and products contributed by GM.
The deal is likely to be the biggest sports sponsorship ever, the paper said.
Although companies have sponsored the Olympics in the past, there has never been a contract for future games like this one, the article said.
